page.overview:
Who is Jack Duvall?

Unnamed paternal grandfather † Scott Duvall (father) Becky Duvall † (mother) Jessica Duvall † (aunt) Gretchen Duvall † (cousin)

Jack Duvall is a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. He is the late son of Scott and the late Becky Duvall.

Jack was a young toddler bearing a strong resemblance to his father, having short blonde hair and many of his facial features. From his mother's side, he appeared to have her eyes.

Typical for an toddler male, Jack wore a light blue onesie.
